integrity: The proof is unbounded and exhaustive on the two nonsquarefree factorization shapes \(p^3\) and \(p^2q\). It reduces the original divisibility exactly to congruence conditions modulo \(16\) and \(36\). The finite verifier is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only nonsquarefree integers in the exact layer \(\Omega(n)=3\). The squarefree \(pqr\) branch, all higher multiplicity layers, and counting asymptotics are outside the claim.
title: The nonsquarefree third multiplicity layer of \(\tau(n)^2\mid\sigma(n)+\varphi(n)\)
